Who We Are: Interra Health is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey.

Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability.

Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone.

The Role: The Lead Account Manager is a strategic, customer-facing player-coach responsible for managing a portfolio of high-value accounts while helping build a more consistent and scalable account management function across Interra Health.

This role may support either DoseSpot or pVerify based on business need and is expected to evolve as the company continues moving toward a unified, segment-based account management model.

The role reports to the Head of Account Management and partners closely with Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, and Operations to improve retention, strengthen executive relationships, and create clearer visibility into customer health, risk, adoption, and growth opportunities across the segment.

Key Responsibilities: Own a portfolio of high-value accounts with full accountability for retention, growth, and executive relationship management — including business reviews, renewal planning, and C-suite engagement. Coach Account Managers and Senior Account Managers on customer planning, risk mitigation, stakeholder mapping, and growth strategy.

Own proactive outreach to the segment book when new products or features roll out — not waiting for clients to discover them; field objections, clear escalation blockers, track adoption, and flag at-risk accounts to the Head of Account Management.

Lead joint planning conversations with customers to uncover growth opportunities and deepen platform adoption. Build and maintain segment-level reporting on customer health, renewal risk, adoption trends, expansion opportunities, and account-level goals — including ARR growth, usage trends, and health scores — for use in executive communications.

Surface friction points — product gaps, support patterns, onboarding challenges — in a data-informed way that drives action across the business. Serve as the primary voice of the customer for the segment, contributing structured insights to roadmap, packaging, and go-to-market decisions.

Partner with the Head of Account Management to develop consistent AM processes, playbooks, forecasting practices, and operating rhythms. Partner cross-functionally with Product, Support, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to advocate for customer needs and manage complex escalations.

Support the transition from product-based to segment-based account management, helping shape structure and process along the way.

AI Expectations: Leverage AI-enabled tools to improve customer health monitoring, streamline reporting workflows, surface renewal risk earlier, and increase the speed and quality of insights delivered to internal stakeholders and customers.

Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT or Claude is a plus; candidates who use AI thoughtfully to improve execution, prioritization, and decision-making will be well positioned for success in this role.

What You’ll Bring: Degree & Years of Experience: Typically requires 7+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar post-sale commercial role, along with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Knowledge & Application: Brings deep knowledge of account management practices, customer health methodologies, and SaaS commercial models, ideally in healthcare technology. Operates independently, prioritizes effectively across a complex portfolio, and exercises sound judgment in managing renewals, customer risk, and growth opportunities.

Complexity & Problem Solving: Navigates complex, multi-stakeholder customer situations involving renewal risk, product limitations, organizational change, or competitive pressure. Identifies patterns across accounts and translates them into scalable solutions, process improvements, and escalation priorities.

Creates practical frameworks and reporting approaches where they do not yet exist. Collaboration & Interaction: Works cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Support, Marketing, Operations, and executive leadership.

Coaches others while owning a strategic book of business and serves as a key conduit between the field and leadership by translating customer and segment signals into actionable recommendations.

Working Conditions & Environment: Fully remote role within the United States Periodic travel (approximately 15-25%) for customer meetings, team events, and industry conferences Operates in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, PE-backed SaaS environment Requires strong cross-functional collaboration across Product, Sales, Support, and Executive Leadership Ability to manage a complex portfolio of accounts and shifting organizational priorities simultaneously Success in this role requires strong asynchronous communication, thoughtful prioritization, and comfort operating in a remote-first environment Benefits & Perks: 💸 Competitive compensation 🌍 Remote-first Work from anywhere in US.

We also provide a one-time home office stipend to set up your workspace, plus a monthly Wi-Fi reimbursement.

Flexible work Flexible scheduling and core collaboration hours (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET), giving you space for both deep work and real life. ✈ Company-wide offsite We invest in connection—join us for an annual offsite to collaborate, build relationships, and have some fun together. 🌴 Time off that you’re expected to use Flexible PTO designed for real recharge, plus 17 company holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave. 💙 Comprehensive health coverage Choose from multiple medical plan options with significant company premium contributions, along with dental (including orthodontia) and vision coverage for you and your family.

Includes company contributions to HSA/FSA accounts (based on plan selection). 💰 Financial wellness 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future.

About SPARETECH
SPARETECH 's vision is to empower the zero-waste industrial sharing economy by enabling maintenance and procurement teams at manufacturing leaders like Bosch, Porsche, and Nestlé to reduce MRO spend and optimize inventory through accurate part information, internal transparency, and market visibility.
To achieve this, we have built, and continue to build, an AI-powered MRO software that connects all players in the spare parts ecosystem, from manufacturers and suppliers to the people working behind the machines. By facilitating the exchange of data, knowledge, and expertise, we create shared visibility that empowers smarter decisions, reduces waste, and drives seamless collaboration. This connected spare parts intelligence unlocks value that extends far beyond software.
Backed by Insight Partners, SPARETECH is accelerating its growth with a strong focus on product innovation and team excellence. We take pride in our inclusive and collaborative culture, as well as our energetic and committed team.

This role is centered on building strong relationships, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring customers realize ongoing value from Summit ’s solutions.

Location Our Channel Account Manager will be an integral part of our Sales team in EMEA. This role is based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands and Sweden. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation.

We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity The core mission of the Channel Account Manager is to cultivate and expand relationships with our key channel partners which include Distributors, Managed Services Providers, and Resellers. This role combines strategic relationship management and enablement responsibilities with outbound energy and partner development hustle.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for channel partners while simultaneously helping them identify and drive new opportunities for DoiT’s PartnerOps solutions, DoiT Cloud Intelligence, PerfectScale, Select, and Attribute — building the pipeline and partnerships that fuel DoiT's indirect channel growth.

Responsibilities Channel Partner Relationship Management
Serve as the dedicated relationship owner for channel partners, acting as their primary point of contact across commercial, technical, and operational matters.
Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships with key stakeholders at channel partners — including partner principals, channel managers, sales teams, and technical leads.
Conduct regular business reviews with channel partners to assess performance, align on pipeline, and identify growth opportunities.
Represent DoiT at partner events, industry conferences, and partner-hosted summits to strengthen brand presence and deepen relationships.
Pitch, Discovery & Pipeline Development
Lead compelling, confident introductory pitches of DoiT’s solutions to channel partner sales teams and their customers without requiring technical support in room.
Work with the channel partners on executing customer deal registration for DoiT’s solutions.
Work alongside the Channel Account Executive to track all customer deal registrations from the channel partner to move these opportunities from qualification through close.
Channel Strategy & Joint GTM
Develop and execute joint business plans with channel partners, setting clear revenue targets, milestones, and co-sell activities.
Influence channel partner roadmaps and go-to-market strategies to increase DoiT's share of wallet within their customer base.
Collaborate with DoiT's Marketing team on channel-specific campaigns, events and initiatives.
Monitor and report on channel market trends, competitive dynamics, and partner ecosystem developments to inform DoiT's channel strategy.
Partner Enablement
Work alongside DoiT’s Partner Success Team to design and deliver enablement programs equipping channel partner sales and technical teams to effectively position and sell DoiT solutions.
Support channel partners with the tools, materials, and knowledge they need to confidently position DoiT products in end-customer conversations.
Partner with Product and Marketing to develop channel-ready collateral, playbooks, and co-branded materials tailored to channel audiences.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Act as an advocate internally for channel partners — communicating partner needs, deal context, and escalation requests across the organization.
Provide structured feedback to leadership, Product, and GTM Strategy teams on partner performance, competitive intelligence, and market signals from the field.
Ensure clean deal registration, CRM accuracy, and pipeline hygiene across all partner-sourced opportunities.

7+ years of experience in channel sales, partner management, or indirect channel roles.
Proven ability to operate across both strategic partner management and outbound partner development within the same role or program.
Deep understanding of Reseller and MSP business models, channel economics, and the technology distribution landscape.
Strong knowledge of cloud channel programs and partner ecosystems across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
Proven ability to lead an initial product pitch and structured discovery conversation independently, without requiring technical support.
Experience working within FinOps, CloudOps, or cloud cost management domains is a significant advantage; curiosity and willingness to develop deep product knowledge is essential.
Excellent prospecting, relationship-building, communication, and executive presentation skills — equally comfortable opening cold conversations and running senior partner QBRs.
Highly organized with strong CRM discipline and the ability to manage a high volume of partner relationships and active pipeline simultaneously.
Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and energized by building in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.

Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you
Onomi is the HCP engagement and intelligence platform for life sciences. Pharma commercial and medical teams use Onomi to run their HCP engagements, congresses, webinars, advisory boards, and everyday meetings, and to capture what actually happens in them: every interaction captured with consent, matched to the right HCP record, and written back to Veeva or Salesforce in minutes, so the engagement they already pay for comes back as data their teams can act on.

This is Onomi's first dedicated business development role in the US, and you are not starting from zero.

We have a strong US account management and event services team on the ground, a US customer base of 100 referenceable pharma companies including AstraZeneca, Takeda, Sanofi, GSK, and BeOne, and over 500,000 HCPs engaged across our platform every month.

Our go-to-market is event-first: our leadership team speaks at the industry's events, usually with a booth alongside, and you will be there with them; at key conventions we prospect as participants, where our customers gather; our biweekly webinars hand you a warm, named audience after every session.

What has been missing are the people on the ground converting that presence and proof into new logos. We are hiring 3 talents at once as our founding US new-business group, working directly with the CEO, the leadership team, and senior sales colleagues in other regions.

[35%] Work industry events: build target lists from attendee data before each event, staff the booth at leadership's speaking events, prospect conventions as a participant (first alongside colleagues, then solo), and follow up with every named contact with relevant messaging.
[20%] Run personalized outbound to webinar audiences and industry event attendee lists, turning warm names into booked first meetings. No mass sequences; every message is yours and very specific.
[20%] Run first meetings: your three-slide story, sharp discovery questions, and a crisp follow-up that gets forwarded internally.
[25%] Progress opportunities with senior support: bring in a senior seller, our solutions team or our leadership team at the right moment, keep every deal moving in an open deal channel, and co-sell through scoping and close.

s.t:
Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them.
Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and run mock first meetings that convince the team you can do it alone.
Start outbound on your first event attendee list and webinar audience, and book your first attended meetings.

s.h: In your first 3 months, you will
s.t:
Have 30+ attended first meetings on the board, with a 70%-plus show rate.
Staff your first medical convention solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up.
Convert each webinar cycle into at least 2 attended meetings.
Have your first opportunities in discovery with a senior co-seller attached.
By month 6, you will have closed your first new US logo, co-sold with a senior colleague (for which you will get 100% quota retirement), and earned a clear conversation about your lane: toward closing bigger deals or leading meeting generation as we scale the team.

s.h: What you need to be great at
s.t:
Speed and consistency despite ambiguity: following up same day, never dropping a ball, staying creative when the playbook runs out.
Curiosity about the product and the customer: you ask why a customer runs things the way they do, you go into the layers underneath.
Nobody expects you to become a sales engineer, but if your answer to every product question is 'let me loop someone in,' buyers lose interest and the someone loses patience.
In-person presence: you are at your best on a floor, at a booth, in a hallway conversation, and you want to travel to make that happen (expect to hop on a plane every 2-3 weeks).
Taking feedback fast: we coach constantly; what we correct on Monday shows up in your work on Tuesday.
Working with support rather than an army: you handle what you can and escalate deliberately.
Writing that sells: short, specific, personal messages that get replies.

s.h: What we are most curious about
s.t:
Tell us about events or trade shows you have worked on: what you did before, on, and after the floor, and what it produced, with real numbers.
Walk us through a product you sold and what sat underneath it: how it worked, why customers chose it, what its limits were.
What are 2 or 3 outreach tactics that reliably got you replies and meetings, and how did you know they worked?
Tell us about the last piece of feedback that changed how you work, and what changed.
